verdict.rationale: The evidence only says Retell's SDKs use API key auth. Nothing in the pack shows keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent with least privilege. Credential scoping is a fair question for an API-driven SaaS platform, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
